div.div: Values are stored in persistent memory with a checksum. If the calculated checksum does not match the stored one, the values are deemed corrupt.

div.div: Persistent flags are double stored meaning that two bits are used to store each flag. If the two bits does not match, the flags are deemed corrupt.
